configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86 -- SDL2, both GL devices + Pixomatic, one binary
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build. SDL2Drv + OpenGLDrv (desktop GL) + GL4ESDrv (GL->GLES2 translation) + PixoDrv (Michael Abrash's software rasterizer, -SOFTWARERENDERER) all in ONE binary; pick at startup with -OPENGLRENDERER / -GL4ESRENDERER / -SOFTWARERENDERER. No Karma -- that is `native-karma`, and the pair is the A/B that reproduces the web and Android ports' physics behaviour on a debuggable desktop. Builds in build-native/ -> ut2004-pixo.bin. [ufront 2.34]

configurePresets.name: native-karma
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86 -- as `native`, plus Karma reference physics
configurePresets.description: `native` + BUILD_KARMA_REF: Karma (metoolkit) reference physics, i.e. Onslaught vehicles and ragdolls. Exists as the other half of the Karma on/off A/B -- the web and Android builds ship WITHOUT Karma, and this pair is how that behaviour is reproduced somewhere a debugger can reach it. Windows has no Karma variant on purpose: metoolkit ships MSVC-mangled C++ prebuilts only (ufront 2.34 section 2.1). Builds in build-native-karma/ -> ut2004-karma-pixo.bin.

configurePresets.name: karma-ref
configurePresets.description: Karma reference physics WITHOUT Pixomatic. Kept as the narrower A/B of the Karma change itself; `native-karma` is what the 2.34 matrix builds.

configurePresets.name: physics
configurePresets.description: gl4es stack with WITH_PHYSICS=ON. Builds in build-physics/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions + exception catching. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. NOT the small one: DWARF plus un-cleaned-up inlining makes it the largest of the three. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. ~5x the wasm and a much slower boot. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O3, assertions off, no debug info -> smaller/faster. Builds in build-wasm-perf/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x86 (MinGW-w64) -- SDL2, both GL devices
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build (MinGW-w64 cross from Linux). SDL2 + BOTH GL render devices (OpenGLDrv desktop GL and GL4ESDrv) in one static exe, picked at startup with -OPENGLRENDERER / -GL4ESRENDERER. TWO things are deliberately absent, both for the same reason -- the drop ships a Windows binary we cannot use: (1) Karma, whose metoolkit libs are MSVC-mangled C++ that MinGW cannot link (2.34 section 2.1); (2) Pixomatic, whose Thirdparty/Pixomatic/Lib/pixomatic.lib turns out to be a pure IMPORT library -- all 240 members are `pixomatic.dll`, and that DLL is not in the drop, so the exe would fail at load. Everything needed to build it IS in place (the header now compiles under MinGW and the lib is selected per-platform); supply pixomatic.dll and flip USE_PIXOMATIC back on. Do not re-derive this. Builds in build-windows/. [ufront 2.33, SDL2 2.34]
